new_results.statement: For H=[[0,0,a,0],[0,0,p,q],[a,p,b,c],[0,q,c,e]], s=s3(H) obeys s<=(|e|+sqrt(e^2+4q^2))/2; hence |q|<s implies |e|>=s-q^2/s.

For two literal independent zero-self hub coordinates and an orthonormal 2D projection (L,V) of a disjoint cap-one product bank, Q=2aX1L+2X2(pL+qV)+bL^2+2cLV+eV^2 has ||p_Q||inf<9.644/s3(H), uniformly in all coefficients and without independence of L,V.

proof_mechanism: LPP supplies the unconditional 2D projected density cap. A rank-two cross branch conditions on the whole projected pair and integrates the reciprocal radius via exact 2D rearrangement. A complementary square branch conditions only a literal original hub, completes the transverse square, and uses the source-pinned planar receiver. A rank-two deterministic approximation forces transverse square curvature when the second crossing is small. Optimizing the two branches yields the universal planar-chamber constant.
